description.p: Helios is an unofficial client for the Amazon Luna cloud gaming service. It provides a dedicated app window for Luna game streaming on Linux with controller support, fullscreen play, and a persistent login session.

Helios is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Amazon. Amazon Luna is a trademark of Amazon.com, Inc. An active Amazon account is required, and game availability depends on your Luna subscription and region.

ul.li: Dedicated window for Luna, no browser setup required
Gamepad support (DualSense, Xbox, and other standard controllers)
Fullscreen streaming with pointer and keyboard capture
Remembers your Amazon login between sessions

description.p: Initial release: Luna streaming window with user agent handling, gamepad passthrough, and fullscreen support.
